title: Align & Ascend | Rooftop Yoga Flow and Tarot Readings
description: Join us for a sunset party on the roof of Colton House Hotel.
long_description:
Join us for a sunset party on the roof of Colton House Hotel.

About this Event

Join Collette OM at Colton House Hotel for a special Halloween-season evening of tarot, yoga, and connection on the rooftop
.Begin with guided journaling and meditation before moving through a gentle, tarot-inspired yoga practice as the sun sets over Austin. After class, stay for a complimentary cocktail or mocktail, light bites, and mingling. A limited number of Empress Tier tickets also include a private three-card Tarot reading with Collette.
Each ticket includes:
1-hour guided sunset yoga
Journaling and meditation
1 cocktail or mocktail
Light bites
Free parking
Empress Tier: Includes everything above plus a private three-card Tarot reading.
Arrival: Please arrive between 5:30–5:45 PM. Yoga begins promptly at 6 PM.
Park in the Colton House garage and meet at the elevator near Simona’s. Our team will guide you to the rooftop.
